address.title: Bluetooth MAC Address
address.description: BLE MAC address of your BedJet V3. On Linux, find it with: sudo hcitool lescan

scanTimeout.title: Scan Timeout (seconds)
scanTimeout.description: How long to scan for the device before giving up (default: 30)

defaultMode.title: Default Mode (when turned on)
defaultMode.description: Mode to activate when the BedJet is turned on from HomeKit

defaultTemperature.title: Default Temperature °F (when turned on)
defaultTemperature.description: Target temperature to set when turned on, in °F. Range: 66–109°F. Leave blank to keep the BedJet's last-used temperature.

defaultFanSpeed.title: Default Fan Speed % (when turned on)
defaultFanSpeed.description: Fan speed to set when turned on (5–100% in 5% steps). Leave blank to keep the BedJet's last-used speed.

defaultRuntimeHours.title: Runtime Hours (on every adjustment)
defaultRuntimeHours.description: Countdown timer sent to the BedJet whenever HomeKit sets a mode, temperature, or fan speed, overriding the unit's per-mode default runtime (e.g. 30 minutes for heat). 12 requests the firmware maximum for the current mode/temperature. Leave blank to keep the BedJet's own defaults.

smartHeat.title: Smart Heat (auto-pick heat mode by temperature)
smartHeat.description: When HomeKit asks for Heat, automatically use Extended Heat for targets of 92°F or below (runs up to ~13h) and regular Heat above that (firmware caps runtime by temperature: ~4h at 93–97°F, 2h at 100°F, 1h at 104°F). Temperature changes that cross 92°F switch modes automatically.
